name: xyz.crossgrain/epitaxy
description: Federal drug shortages and recalls joined to the federal contracts that buy those drugs.

environmentVariables.name: EPITAXY_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the API. Defaults to https://drugs.crossgrain.xyz

environmentVariables.name: EPITAXY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Without it the free tier is used: 20 rows, no evidence, no weak matches, data delayed by 24 hours. No signup required.
